text:
lee: Incoming pen-test intake from ProbeWorks. They need a retest window + evidence access. Who takes KMS policy and RBAC scope? cc @maria @arjun @sam

maria: I can own KMS. We must avoid granting broad kms:Decrypt. Plan: evidence key with key policy that only allows AssessorRole ARN + sourceIp; require encryption context check.

sam: I'll own RBAC mapping and tickets. Ephemeral OIDC-assumed role only, TTL 48h. No long-lived creds.

arjun: For artifacts use presigned S3 URLs created by an internal packaging job that also redacts prompts. TTL 24h by default; if vendor needs more -> issue short AssumeRole and keep downloads logged.

lee: Vendor asked for flushed KV-cache events from runtime for timing analysis. We can emit event type runtime.kv.flush with hashed keys only. Confirm we won't leak prompt text.

maria: Confirmed — redact prompt text and replace with SHA256 hashes. Keep mapping only in secure vault (audit-only access).

sam: Remediation priority for retest scheduling proposed:
- P0: auth bypass, KMS key overly permissive, data exfil path
- P1: missing audit trails, presigned URL misuse, logs containing secrets
Please ack owners and ETAs for P0s.

arjun: SIEM rules: alert on AssumeRole by external principal + kms:Decrypt or s3:GetObject. Auto-create ticket and notify #sec-alerts. Also create a playbook to revoke AssessorRole on anomalous activity.

ops-bot: Reminder: PT kickoff in 45 minutes — https://meet.link/pt-kickoff :bell:

maria: Draft key policy I'll propose (inline): allow kms:Decrypt only to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AssessorRole when aws:SourceIp = vendor netblock and StringEquals kms:EncryptionContext:purpose=pt-evidence.

sam: I'll create PT-JIRA board and tickets today. Tentative retest slots: next Thu 09:00-12:00 or Mon 13:00-16:00. Vendor wants 48h notice.

lee: Checklist I'm adding to intake doc: 1) Create AssessorRole + assume policy; 2) KMS key policy change + security review; 3) Implement redact pipeline & packaging; 4) Presigned artifact delivery; 5) SIEM rules + playbook; 6) Create JIRA tickets + schedule retest; 7) Legal DPA sign-off before decrypts.

maria: ETA for KMS policy change: EOD tomorrow pending quick review. I'll post the ARN and presigned URL pattern once live.

sam: Good. Owners update ETAs in JIRA. We'll lock retest after legal confirms DPA. Thanks.
